steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Incoming—Three 'o clock!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Hyah!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Watch out, above you!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: That was close...

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: There's too many of them! Why are there infected creatures down here?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: All these years and you still haven't broken that habit of asking pointless questions.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: None of these pests should be allowed to go any further. I can't imagine what would happen to the village if they broke free.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: There's more coming! On your right!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: —Gah, my blade! Curses, it's becoming even more dull from the sheer numbers we're dealing with.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: We have to stop them from coming... If I'm not wrong, there are still some pretty powerful Originium bombs in my bag from our last mission; they can be remotely detonated.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Just gotta think of a way to trigger one without blowing up us too...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: That ventilation shaft.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: It opens up into the inner walls of the cave, so we can use a bomb to blow open the covering and give us an escape route.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: After we're out, we can then quickly detonate the bombs below and cause a cave-in to trap them in... It's definitely feasible.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: But the explosion will also weaken the cave's structure, so we'll have limited time to escape. We'll have to be fast.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I'll go plant the explosives, but I'll need someone to block the infected creatures, can you handle that?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Why even ask? I'll hold them off, go set them up.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Be careful.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Hey, I'm right here! Don't even think of looking anywhere else!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Quickly now... Alright! Set up complete!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Top bomb ready for detonation!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: It opened up... Damage within expectations.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: You head up first! I'll keep them at bay here!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: No, too dangerous. You'd probably end up getting buried alive.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Just listen to me for once, or one of them might slip past.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: ...Fine, then you follow my instructions.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I'm up! Corne, evacuate immediately!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: I'm coming, hup—

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Ah!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: What's the matter?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: The ladder broke...

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: What? How?! Chikushou!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Calm down, Yato! I'm fine!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Stay calm, stay calm, let me think... Right! I have an idea!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Position your shield between yourself and the bomb, then detonate it and use the force of the shockwave to launch yourself up!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: I'll definitely catch you.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Got it.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Get ready!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Jump!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Alright—I've got you!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Get—up—here—

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: My body—I'm fine! That was perfect!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Corne... You should think about going on a diet.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: ...Guess I'll ask Hibiscus for ideas when we get back.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: So are we in the forest?

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Smithy, over here! The two long-horned people meownaged to escape!

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: Mew escaped!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: How do you guys always just pop up out of nowhere?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: ...Those chunks of meat were deliberately placed to lure something out from the cave, and we were almost certainly the targets.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: But we managed to escape, so their plan should have failed.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Could it have been the villager who gave us the cave's location?

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: It doesn't matter who did it. We managed to at least block the cave entrance for now, so it's going to be difficult for the headman to make any further moves against us, and I doubt he intends to destroy his own village.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: If the source of Oripathy and the Rathalos are both connected to the cave, then the most direct solution would be to... find out where the cave goes.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Based on its trajectory, it probably ends somewhere within this mountain range, but the exact location will be hard to determine.

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: What if we looked for the Rathalos instead?

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: The cave's condition... implies it's been in there before, at the very least, and it might even be at the endpoint you're talking about.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Yes, that's very likely.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Considering that returning to the village will only put us in a sticky situation, there's only one path left for us.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: We head deeper into the forest to find the Rathalos.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Wait just a meowment!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Mew just went through a thrilling crisis, and are about to embark on an exciting journey chasing a Rathalos. A Felyne's life truly never pawses!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: So furst! We have to fill up our stomachs! Come enjoy the uniqueness of Felyne cuisine!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Ain't these just leftovers?!

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Mew know nothing, the taste has changed not one bit!

steps.name: Noir Corne
steps.text: Fine... I'm craving some meat, so give me a piece.

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: Me too.

steps.name: Felyne Scholar
steps.text: Ecological Research team! Onward!

steps.name: Felyne Artisan
steps.text: New meowterials! Furward!

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: (chewing)

steps.name: Yato
steps.text: The Rathalos... will have to wait.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Ritou, give me one good reason why you led them to the cave.

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: It's simple. Didn't they tell you they were going to deal with that monster? I simply created the perfect conditions for them.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Do you understand what would happen if outsiders found out about our secret?

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: Of course, of course. Even your niece who only comes back once in a blue moon made such a ruckus when she found out.

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: If a company familiar with Originium like Rhodes Island found out, the consequences would be unthinkable.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: So are you ready to handle said consequences?

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: They will die down there.

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: Think about it carefully, Headman. We're both former hunters. I've laid out the bait, and as we both know, beasts are most tempted by the scent of blood.

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: They'll encounter that monster long before they discover our secret and— Bam! The battle begins.

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: If they're weak, the monster will take care of them for us, and we won't have to worry about any consequences.

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: And if by some chance they can take care of the monster, then wouldn't that also be a win for us? Threat successfully eliminated.

spans.text: And if by some chance they
take care of the monster, then wouldn't that also be a win for us? Threat successfully eliminated.

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: I had some people wait for them to enter, and follow after a short while.

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: Surely they'll be weak and injured after fighting the monster, so if we want to dispose of them, that would be our best opportunity.

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: No matter how it ends up, we benefit.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: You have clearly put a lot of thought into this.

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: And of course, whichever way it goes... it'll be better than you sealing the cave off and stubbornly concealing everything.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Hmph...

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: Oh, don't look so serious. I knew you might be concerned about it, so I just helped you out a little, that's all.

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: After all, Akira is no longer with us, so I'm your right-hand man.

steps.name: Nervous Villager
steps.text: Headman, it's a disaster! Someone blew up the cave at the back of the village!

steps.name: Nervous Villager
steps.text: The entrance... has been blocked off by rubble.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: I understand, bring some men with you to clean up the debris and re-open the cave.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: You can go now.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Ritou, was this also part of your brilliant plan?

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: Oh? This was indeed outside my calculations.

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: But since the cave was blown up, I can't imagine they survived the aftermath, so they probably died along with the monster. No matter.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: What you've done today...

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: I will weigh the pros and cons for the village and decide whether to hold you accountable for your actions later.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: However, for now I'll send a search party to make sure they stay silent.

steps.name: Hiroshi Ritou
steps.text: Works out nicely then, doesn't it? Well, I'll be heading back. There are still quite a few bills I need to go through.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: See yourself out.

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: *sigh*

steps.name: Ataru Takii
steps.text: Akira, you were right...

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Hm?

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: The leaves are falling.

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: So autumn is already here...

steps.name: Yoshitaka Kashiwau
steps.text: Let's go, Akira.
